hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in */nextjs-pickball/*.ts|*/nextjs-pickball/*.tsx|*/nextjs-pickball/*.js|*/nextjs-pickball/*.jsx|*/nextjs-pickball/*.mjs|*/nextjs-pickball/*.cjs) pnpm --filter ./nextjs-pickball lint "$FILE" 1>&2 || exit 2 ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); echo "$f" | grep -qE 'wrangler\.(jsonc|json|toml)$' || exit 0; case "$f" in */hono-pickball/*) dir="hono-pickball" ;; */nextjs-pickball/*) dir="nextjs-pickball" ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$dir" || exit 0; if command -v fnm >/dev/null 2>&1; then fnm exec --using="$(cat .node-version 2>/dev/null || echo 22)" -- pnpm cf-typegen >&2 || true; else pnpm cf-typegen >&2 || true; fi
